description: Operations workspace for qualifying trade show leads. Contains the raw tradeshow leads spreadsheet, recent sales-team emails bearing on eligibility, the lead qualification policy, and supporting reference records. The user wants leads qualified and a summary prepared for review before any HubSpot records are created or any email is sent.

qualification_policy.content: Lead Qualification Policy v4. A lead is QUALIFIED if: (1) not already an existing/active account, (2) company is not a sole proprietor or under $5,000 EstAnnualValue, (3) Qualified column is not already 'Yes'. A qualified lead is DEAL-ELIGIBLE (prioritized for the deal pipeline) if EstAnnualValue >= $50,000.00. Pipeline value = sum of EstAnnualValue across deal-eligible leads, reported verbatim from the source. Existing accounts and previously-qualified rows must be skipped, not re-created.

deal_pipeline_reference.content: HubSpot deal pipeline 'New Business 2026' reference. Stages: Appointment Scheduled -> Qualified to Buy -> Proposal -> Negotiation -> Closed Won. New trade-show deal-eligible leads are normally entered at 'Qualified to Buy' with deal amount = EstAnnualValue. Pipeline owner: RevOps. Note: entries here are live and notify the assigned rep on creation.

tools.name: read_tradeshow_leads

tools.name: find_sales_emails
tools.description: Search the sales team shared inbox for recent messages that may affect lead eligibility and return matching message headers.

tools.name: get_email_content
tools.description: Retrieve the full body of a specific sales-team email by its message ID for review of eligibility notes.

tools.name: score_lead_qualification
tools.description: Apply the Lead Qualification Policy against the leads and email eligibility notes to determine which leads are qualified and which are deal-eligible, computing total pipeline value verbatim.

tools.name: read_qualification_policy
tools.description: Read the Lead Qualification Policy describing qualification and deal-eligibility criteria and pipeline value rules.
